scope: Três reinterpretacoes autorais de criaturas lendárias, com Crystal Pipa; não integrado.

creatures.name: Grifarca
creatures.fact: O museu descreve um grifo como combinação de corpo de leão com cabeça e asas de ave de rapina; o exemplar citado possui cabeça de falcão.
creatures.interpretation: Híbrido aéreo-terrestre com atitude vigilante. Criamos cabeça de ave, dois membros anteriores de garras aviárias, posteriores leoninos e duas asas de membranas plumiformes.
creatures.review: Quatro membros separados: dois anteriores aviários e dois posteriores leoninos. Duas asas com raízes distintas atrás dos ombros, cauda/rabiola completa, rosto de ave com bico e olhos azuis. Crystal Pipa alinhado sob a base do pescoço entre raízes anteriores; núcleo e quilha no mesmo eixo.
creatures.unknown: Montagem em vista única; asas e patas precisam de outra vista para provar amplitude e voo.
creatures.prompt:
Use case stylized-concept. ONE original mature legendary SOULMONSTER GRIFARCA, reinterpretation of a GRIFFIN as a bearer of CRYSTAIS PIPAS. Reference1 is our own crystal identity sheet; reference2 is our own Vesperalito for clean 2D manga contour and sculptural armor density only. Do NOT copy its beast head, body, palette or collar design. NO external franchise characters.

True griffin construction: head and neck of a proud large bird of prey, powerful HOOKED IVORY BEAK with dark tip, small piercing SAPPHIRE BLUE EYES, angular orbital brow and two short folded paper crest feathers swept back. No lion face under bird helmet, no teeth or human lips. Deep strong bird/lion chest; TWO forelegs ending in eagle talons, TWO hindlegs leonine ending in broad clawed paws. Exactly FOUR legs rooted coherently plus TWO LARGE wings with their own scapular roots behind shoulder sockets. One wing half raised showing broad folded paper-feather vanes, other extended diagonally back; count every limb and do not hide hindlegs. Rear body and pelvis compact muscular lion, weight on four feet, head upright vigilant in threequarter pose.

Living kite material is anatomical: wings are a few broad LAYERED pearl-paper feather sails whose curved leading ribs are fine ivory bamboo with bronze knots at roots; a few large engraved-like folds inside sails, not realistic feather noise or plain triangular wings. Armor is LAPI SAPPHIRE BLUE and aged pale bronze with ivory neck feathers, a substantial overlapping shoulder mantle following wing roots, lamellar foreleg guards and a proud FRONT breastplate. ONE Crystal Pipa mounted centrally beneath neck on anatomical STERNUM between foreleg roots, not on side or wing. Same pale-lilac asymmetric kite, broad upper shoulders and elongated lower point with small stepped notches, mint cross-spine and woven center knot, copper THREE-point mount sides and bottom; top tip free. Front chest halves converge around it in perspective, gem axis and chest keel align. Thin violet seam channels distribute to wing root bindings, no blaze aura. Clawed feet support actual torso weight.

Color identity ivory/white living feathers, royal sapphire armor, smoky slate leonine body, pale bronze accents, sapphire blue eyes (NOT orange amber yellow), lilac gem and mint core. Single complete long lion-tail/rabiola emerges rear pelvis as tapered slate paper cord with ONE layered ivory/sapphire kite plume terminal. One soul, no extra tails. Original mature creature, regal predatory authority, armor rich and structurally articulated but not human knight in gryphon costume. 45% creature45% living kite10% selective stepped dark contour/2D manga. Crisp flat cel-shaded color 2-3 hard shadow tones, dark confident lines, matte planes, no shiny photoreal metal, no painterly gradients or 3D, no allover crumpled origami. White LANDSCAPE fullbody canvas, safe margin around both wings, feet crest and rabiola, no text or extra views.

creatures.name: Gevoraz
creatures.source_title: Au loup ! La Bête du Gévaudan — dossier documentaire EAC 2021–2022
creatures.fact: O resumo da p. 2 situa ataques entre 1764 e 1767 e registra que a identidade do animal ou animais continua debatida. Rumo de interpretação não equivale a identificação zoológica.
creatures.interpretation: Monstro canídeo de lenda, não reconstrução histórica. Ombros altos, mandíbula longa, crista de papel rasgado e proteção assimétrica traduzem ameaça e incerteza.
creatures.review: Quatro membros com apoios, duas orelhas recuadas, crista de papel e mandíbula dentada. Olhos rosa pálido, não laranja. Montagem do cristal convergente na frente do peito; uma rabiola trançada com terminal único.
creatures.unknown: Não concluir que a Besta histórica tinha esta aparência, armadura, poderes ou vínculo com os Crystais Pipas.
creatures.prompt:
Use case stylized-concept. ONE original mature SOULMONSTER GEVORAZ, a fictional reinterpretation inspired by the LEGEND OF THE BEAST OF GEVAUDAN, not a claim about the real historical animal. Reference1 own Crystal Pipa artifact, preserve identity. Reference2 own Vesperalito for 2D manga line/cel finish and late-stage armor volume only. Do NOT copy its face, armor arrangement, colors or generic mask. No existing franchise creature.

Create a deeply characteristic terrifying EARTHBOUND QUADRUPED of canid ancestry distorted by legend: enormous high narrow shoulders, unusually DEEP narrow ribcage, long lean tucked abdomen, low haunches, long strong forelegs and spring-loaded rear legs, broad heavy forepaws with 4 hooked dark claws, rear paws smaller. EXACTLY FOUR limbs, all roots coherent, not werewolf biped. VERY LONG CROOKED lower neck carries a large low predatory head with long wide bony muzzle, heavy raised nasal bridge, deep-set tiny PALE ICY ROSE eyes and dark pupils (never orange yellow amber), low torn triangular ears swept backwards. Jaw opened in a narrow stalking snarl with coherent upper/lower jaw, a few large irregular visible fangs, cheek crests angular and long. Not friendly dog, hyena laugh, fluffy wolf mascot, human skull or beak. Head and jaw must be distinctive, mature and unnerving.

Story material: the beast's living-paper hide looks like layered charcoal broadsheet paper and rust-red membranes compressed into ARMOR from the terror of a legend. NO real letters, blood or gore. Tall coarse irregular black paper MANE forms a ragged ridge from skull to shoulder hump with 4-5 large swept clusters, not hundreds of spikes. Armor is asymmetric articulated weathered DARK IRON-GRAY/burgundy plates with bone-ivory edges, narrow dull red tension knots; massive near shoulder guard resembles an offset curved trap-jaw crescent framing shoulder, not an actual beartrap prop. The opposite shoulder has a lower wedge guard. Front greaves are heavy overlapping dark plates, abdomen remains lean exposed burgundy membrane, hips have a few layered panels. Armor has menace and weight, not barrels or sack pauldrons. Cream neck folds are sparse; body stays mostly graphite/rust-red, NO plum/ochre hyena palette.
ONE pale-lilac Crystal Pipa on ANTERIOR MIDLINE OF THE STERNUM below neck base, between front shoulder roots. Chest armor halves converge to central keel. Crystal must not sit on near flank. Same broad upper kite shoulders, long narrow lower tip, stepped lower notches, mint inner cross-spine and central woven knot; copper THREE point cradle sides+bottom top free. Size restrained so face and predatory silhouette remain focal. Thin violet seam channels enter foreleg guards, NO fullbody flames. Single long heavy dark braided rabiola follows tail out of rump ending in ONE rust-red/ivory torn hooked pennant, one tail no disconnected ribbons.
Pose prowling and braced, near paw forward, head low toward viewer but shoulders loom above it. Sharp large-medium-small hierarchy, armor/body gaps show living muscle-like paper compression. 45% creature45% living kite10% clean dark selective stepped contour 2D manga. Pale ROSE eyes, graphite, rust-red, bone-white, aged copper and lilac core. Crisp flat cel shading2-3 hard shadow planes, bold ink, no 3D metal gloss or painterly texture, no wet fur, no noise, no generic demon symbols. White landscape fullbody safe margins around mane, claws, tail, no text no extra views.

creatures.name: Makaréu
creatures.fact: O museu descreve makara associado à água e, nesse exemplar de Java Central, guardião de entrada de templo com tromba e chifres de carneiro. Trata-se de uma representação específica, não anatomia universal.
creatures.interpretation: Composto aquático autoral com tromba curta acima da mandíbula, chifres enrolados, dois membros anteriores palmados e parte posterior de peixe. Placas em ondas, canais e membranas de pipa integram a silhueta.
creatures.review: Dois membros anteriores palmados, sem patas traseiras; corpo contínuo até uma nadadeira caudal larga. Tromba sobre mandíbula, dois chifres enrolados e guelras de papel. Rabiola menor presa à raiz da nadadeira. Cristal no eixo frontal sob a mandíbula, não na lateral.
creatures.unknown: Não reproduz exatamente uma escultura nem define atributos de toda a tradição. Corpo aquático e habilidades propostas sem teste de natação.
creatures.prompt:
Use case stylized-concept. ONE ORIGINAL adult SOULMONSTER MAKAREU, a fantastical reinterpretation inspired by the mythical aquatic MAKARA of Indic/Java art traditions, not a copy of any sculpture, deity or modern franchise. Reference1 is own Crystal Pipa artifact identity. Ref2 own Vesperalito ONLY clean2D manga/cel armor density; do not copy mammal head, fourleg anatomy or petrol/ivory palette. This guardian must be AQUATIC and strikingly unlike a wolf, serpent cobra, griffin or humanoid.

Anatomy: huge deep-bodied water beast with a crocodilian/elephant composite head, SHORT upward-curled PREHENSILE TRUNK grows from the upper muzzle ABOVE a wide strong TOOTHED lower jaw, two compact rolled ivory horn sheaths behind temples curve like a RAM in profile, eyes SMALL SILVERY TURQUOISE with dark pupils, no orange yellow amber. Trunk is living folded paper with clear curve and nostril end, no second head, no attached elephant face. Two broad cheek gill fans of folded paper integrate behind jaw. Powerful high chest with EXACTLY TWO forelimbs emerging as strong webbed clawed FLIPPERS; NO hindlegs or walking paws. Long deep fishlike lower body curls into a compact crescent behind, terminates in ONE enormous broad folded caudal fan of indigo/coral-paper fins. The fan is BODY TAIL, and from its central root a SINGLE short fine braided rabiola extends away ending in one small turquoise/ivory pennant; make connection legible, do not confuse extra animal tail or soul. Clear two forelimb roots and body-tail continuity.

Aquatic armor: sculptural DARK INDIGO and seafoam-green broad overlapping shell plates like rolled cresting waves, edges aged pale bronze and coral-red inner surfaces, small mint bindings at joints. Anterior shoulder shields frame broad sternum under jaw/trunk, flexible throat and belly membranes seafoam shaded deep ultramarine, large compressed folds create living mass. Few broad rib bands along fish body, no hundreds of scales or realistic skin. A thick layered collar has asymmetrical wave crests, not crown, random spikes or ordinary medieval suit.
ONE CRYSTAL PIPA at FRONT MIDLINE OF CHEST just under jaw between TWO flipper roots: pale lilac kite mineral with broad upper shoulders, long lower tip with little stepped notches, mint frozen cross-spine and central woven knot, three copper cradles sides+bottom, top free. Embed firmly in convex chest armor; keep artifact axis aligned with throat and central keel, not on flank. Thin lavender energy channels follow collar then flipper edges, no flame. Air/water shown only as 2 small graphic curling pressure ribbons below flippers, not ocean background.

Pose suspended above simple faint shadow as if buoyant, facing viewer 3/4 with trunk raised and jaw partially open, near flipper extended braced, far flipper visible, tail curling behind into large fan. Adult formidable benevolent guardian, not baby sea mascot. Color identity seafoam, dark indigo, coral-red accents, aged bronze, SILVERY TURQUOISE EYES; lilac artifact remains group signature. 45% creature45% kite anatomy10% selective pixel-like stepped dark outline/clean2D MANGA. Large medium small hierarchy and rich coherent armor, flat matte cel colors2-3 hard shadow planes, crisp confident black ink, no glossy 3D metal, no painterly gradients or photoreal fish. White LANDSCAPE fullbody concept, generous safe margins around trunk horns caudal fan flippers and rabiola; NO text or inset views.
